decisions.detail: QUOTE: Tiers 3 and 4 "Accumulate. Nothing stated can remove them." and "Stated value vs tier 3 or 4 fact: both apply. The fact is never discarded." alongside "Any stated value replaces them" (tier 5) and "the flag ... replaces the declared value for that option as a whole. It does not merge." | WHY: The answer contrasts stated tiers that replace one another with discovered-fact layers that accumulate and survive any stated value. || QUOTE: "Stated value vs tier 3 or 4 fact:** both apply.
